advisor_identified: Ivo Nikolai Lambi, historian of nineteenth-century Germany at the University of Saskatchewan from 1961; supervisor of John W. T. Gaston’s 1975 PhD.

doctorate.title: Free Trade and Protection in Germany, 1868-1879

evidence.says: University of Saskatchewan Archives’ biographical history states that Ivo Nikolai Lambi completed his PhD at the University of Minnesota in 1958, joined Saskatchewan’s History Department in 1961, and specialized in nineteenth-century German history.

The History Department lists John W. T. Gaston, PhD 1975, supervisor LAMBI, with the title Policy Making and Free-Trade Diplomacy: Britain’s Commercial Relations with Western Europe, 1869-1886, matching the student dissertation in this entry.

Bibliographic record identifies Ivo Nikolai Lambi as author of Free Trade and Protection in Germany, 1868-1879, University of Minnesota, 1958, 724 pages; the original copy is from the University of Minnesota.

notes: Institution, year, author and title match linked AHA record 34819. The linked title abbreviates the terminal year as 79. The archives separately list a 1963 published book of the same title; 1958 is the doctorate year.
